evals.prompt: Where is refresh-token rotation implemented, and which code revokes a reused token? Give me only the evidence needed to explain the flow.
evals.expected_output: Uses exact and semantic retrieval, follows relevant call/type edges, and cites a minimal set of symbol-level spans without reading the whole auth subsystem.

evals.prompt: This monorepo has 300,000 files. Design an incremental semantic index with Tree-sitter, embeddings, and a symbol graph, including cache invalidation and branch isolation.
evals.expected_output: Reads the persistent-index reference and produces a language-agnostic architecture with stable chunk identities, transactional per-file updates, versioned caches, bounded processing, and measurable performance criteria.

evals.prompt: Users sometimes receive duplicate invoice emails. Trace the likely path from scheduled job to email provider and identify the smallest set of relevant code.
evals.expected_output: Combines conceptual retrieval with symbol/call expansion, checks configuration and tests only when relevant, labels uncertain edges, and stops once the duplicate-send path is evidenced.

evals.prompt: I renamed a method and modified three lines in its body. Update the repository index without re-embedding unrelated code.
evals.expected_output: Hashes and reparses only the changed file, matches stable chunks, removes stale symbol/edges, embeds only changed chunks, and resolves affected references transactionally.

evals.prompt: Change the button label in src/components/SubmitButton.tsx from Send to Submit.
evals.expected_output: Does not invoke broad repository indexing; opens the known small target directly, verifies the occurrence, and makes the scoped edit.
